source: Additions from decisions made after the main table was generated (2026-11-16): error and warning fields.

notation.data: a field consumer code reads on a slothlet object (errors, warnings)

entries.note: SlothletError and SlothletWarning carry their extra fields on `.details` in v4 (the console label is "Details:"). Rewritten where the value is provably a slothlet error; reported everywhere else.
Removed; the original throw is the standard `cause`.
The process-wide switch is gone. Set `silent: true` in the slothlet() config to keep that instance's warnings off the console; warnings are still created and recorded (api.slothlet.warnings.get()).
The constructor takes (code, details, { cause }). The third positional originalError argument and the validationError / stub flags are gone.
